WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS (
  SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
         e.DEPARTMENT_ID,
         1 AS depth
  FROM employees e
  LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.MANAGER_ID = m.EMPLOYEE_ID
  WHERE e.MANAGER_ID IS NULL
     OR m.DEPARTMENT_ID IS NULL
     OR m.DEPARTMENT_ID <> e.DEPARTMENT_ID
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
         e.DEPARTMENT_ID,
         dt.depth + 1
  FROM employees e
  JOIN dept_tree dt ON e.MANAGER_ID = dt.EMPLOYEE_ID
  WHERE e.DEPARTMENT_ID = dt.DEPARTMENT_ID
),
dept_score AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_ID,
         AVG(depth) AS avg_depth
  FROM dept_tree
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_ID
)
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       ds.avg_depth AS "Organizational Depth Score"
FROM dept_score ds
JOIN departments d ON ds.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
ORDER BY ds.avg_depth DESC
LIMIT 5;

    SELECT employee_id, manager_id, department_id, 0 AS lvl
    FROM emp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.employee_id, m.manager_id, m.department_id, p.lvl + 1
